message:
Bifold doors look amazing.

Covering them? That’s the bit that usually goes wrong.

A curtain rail hides the glass you paid for. One wide roller across the whole opening catches on the handles the first time you fold the doors.

What does work: made-to-measure blinds on each leaf, often motorised, so the fabric travels with the door. BlindScreen® if you need blackout and a fly screen. Shutters if you want a more permanent finish.

New UK buyer’s guide: options, 2026 costs, and what we check on survey:

https://shutter-envy.co.uk/motorised-blinds-for-bifold-doors-uk-buyers-guide/

Based in Melton Mowbray. Free home survey across Leicestershire.
